{{Quote|Gentis rallied thousands of cadets and officers to his cause. For a brief moment, he controlled all of Coruscant's military and political might. He even had the moral conviction that what he was doing was ''right''. But in the end, none of that mattered&hellip;because he didn't have the ''Emperor''.|Admiral Laurita Tohm, in Imperial Incident Report CM-0420-003|<ref name="GhostPrison5" />}}
The '''Ghost Prison incident''' was a military coup that occurred in the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign. The coup was orchestrated and instigated by [[Gentis]], the [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] and a hero of the recently-ended [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After serving [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]-turned-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] throughout the Clone Wars and the early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[General/Legends|General]] Gentis grew weary of war and angry over the continued [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of thousands of young Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he resolved to betray the Imperial establishment by enlisting the first class of Imperial Academy graduates in a conspiracy to overthrow the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and seize control of the Empire, thereby putting an end to destructive campaigns of oppression and expansion.

The coup began on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the evening of the Academy's graduation ceremony. Gentis-allied [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] and [[Bomb/Legends|bombers]] detonated explosives at critical targets throughout [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], while the Empire's newest class of [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] disguised themselves as [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] and [[Military revolt on Coruscant|attacked]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] outside of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], General Gentis and several of his most trusted students personally met with Emperor Palpatine in his [[Imperial Throne Room|throne room]], where they detonated bombs containing the deadly [[Aorth-6]] virus. The [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] quickly killed all of Palpatine's defenders, but the Emperor was spared from death by his own [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities and the intervention of Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]]. Although [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the faithful [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] defeated the attackers outside of the Palace, Emperor Palpatine's weakened condition and Headmaster Gentis's influence on Coruscant forced the loyalists to flee the planet.

[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader and Moff Trachta agreed to take Emperor Palpatine to a location far removed from General Gentis's influence. Calling upon his past experience as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] suggested [[The Prism]], a secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility previously maintained by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and entirely unknown to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Vader, Tohm, and Trachta ferried Palpatine to The Prism, where he was rehabilitated; meanwhile, Gentis consolidated power on Coruscant and moved forward with his plan to seize total control. Given that he was uncertain of the Emperor's survival, he maintained the facade of a terrorist attack and instead decided to target [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]&mdash;one of the Empire's most prominent [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] and [[Politics/Legends|political]] leaders and the head of the secretive [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] project.

On The Prism, Vader and Tohm hatched a plan to retake Coruscant by recruiting an [[Army/Legends|army]] comprised of the prisoners in the facility. After instigating violent [[Mission to the Prism|riots]] to cull the weak and find the strongest of the inmates, the Imperials selected thirty-three former criminals to pardon and reform into a pro-Palpatine fighting force. Their plan reached fruition when the loyalists were able to intercept [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] Tarkin's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''en route'' to Coruscant and confront Gentis. A [[Battle on Coruscant|fierce battle]] erupted between Palpatine's forces and the insurgent officers upon the shuttle's arrival on the planet, but in spite of the revolutionaries' superior numbers, they were quickly overcome. Emperor Palpatine personally killed Headmaster Gentis during the battle, finally ending the coup and reclaiming Coruscant. In the aftermath of the conflict, later dubbed the "Ghost Prison incident," the surviving conspirators were rounded up and executed by firing squad and the events of Gentis's coup were deemed classified by the Imperial government. Trachta and Tohm were promoted to the positions of Grand Moff and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], respectively, and the remaining prisoners from The Prism were killed.

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|I gave the Emperor my ''sons'', and he gave me caskets!|Gentis|<ref name="GhostPrison5" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a few weeks after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] attended a military meeting on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. While seeking to escape the droning of the various [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], he discovered the [[Imperial Crematorium]], and watched hundreds of dead Imperials be incinerated every minute. Realizing that even though the war had ended, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] warmongering ways would never cease, he quickly set about seeking a way to end the senseless killing. The fact that the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] warmongering ways also cost him all of his sons except for [[Caul Gentis|Caul]] only solidified his desire to end it.

===The first class===
{{Quote|You do not need one thousand hours in the tactical simulators, or to survive on starvation rations during a sixteen-day mock siege. In fact, you need only pass a single, simple test... answer one single question-do you have the courage to die for your Empire?|Gentis|<ref name="GhostPrison1" />}}
A few months later, the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of the graduating class of the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] arrived on Coruscant. They were part of six different academies from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] who came to the capital in order to be part of the first graduating class of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. Their training&mdash;like that of the Empire's clones and other military personnel&mdash;had been accelerated from the usual [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to only a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Gentis, a hero of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], presided over the ceremonies. [[Laurita Tohm]] was the valedictorian of the Raithal Academy, and thus was given the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] by Gentis.

Lieutenant Tohm was soon selected to be a part of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but Headmaster Gentis had other plans for the young officer. He ordered [[Ensign/Legends|Ensigns]] [[Caul Gentis|Caul]] and [[Shens]] to keep Tohm "out of harm's way." Tohm's friends locked him inside a [[Imperial starfighter prototype|prototype Imperial starfighter]], and for a time, he assumed it was a practical joke. In reality, this was the first small step in Gentis's coup, as he believed that the promising officer would draw too much attention due to his prominence and deformities. The Headmaster, in truth, cared deeply about those he trained, and orchestrated the coup in part because he knew their new Emperor would never cease throwing Imperials to their [[Death/Legends|deaths]].

===The usurpation of Coruscant===
{{SeeAlso|Military revolt on Coruscant}}
{{Quote|You couldn't be involved&mdash;you always draw too much ''attention''. But you can stand with us ''now''. Kill Darth Vader and the Empire is ''ours''.''"<br />"''You should have asked me ''yesterday''.|Shens pleads with Tohm before the latter executes him|<ref name="GhostPrison2" />}}
Explosions rocked the cityscape for [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] around, eliminating seventy-two Imperial targets within minutes. The officer's club, various [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] garrisons, the Comm Towers, and a supply depot were all destroyed. [[Imperial Plaza (Imperial Palace)|Imperial Plaza]] became ground zero in the battle that erupted, as "terrorist" forces swarmed through the city streets, fighting with the Empire's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. The stormtroopers were losing the battle until the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]],<ref name="kenner" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], appeared, rallying the troops and driving the enemy forces back. In the madness, Tohm had escaped from the prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by engaging its [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejection seat]] and landing in the midst of the battle. Lieutenant Tohm joined the stormtroopers in following [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader, but when one of the terrorists grabbed his ankle, he bent and removed the man's mask, revealing his friend Shens. Shens begged Tohm to help them kill Palpatine, the main target of their [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts that night.

[[File:ThePrism.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Palpatine escaped to a hidden Jedi prison, the Prism.]]
As Shens lay dying, he then asked Tohm to kill Vader, but Tohm told his friend that he should have included him earlier, and shot Shens in the head. The young lieutenant then bowed to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], who instantly respected his bravery and loyalty. As the pair made their way from the plaza, another explosion tore through the nearby buildings, unleashing a powerful necrotic virus known as [[Aorth-6]]. Dozens of Imperials, including [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsmen]], were killed by the aerosolized virus, which liquefied them from the inside out. Lieutenant Tohm donned a breathing device that he had taken from the TIE fighter when he ejected and followed Lord Vader inside. There they found a mortally infected Emperor Palpatine and Moff [[Trachta]]. Palpatine was using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to keep the virus at bay, but was losing the battle even with his formidable powers. Vader accused Trachta of being in league with the conspiracy, but the Moff vehemently denied it, saying they needed to get the Emperor into hiding; fear of his power was the only thing keeping the Empire together. The trio escorted the weakened [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to a secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] below the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], where they loaded him aboard a stealth transport.

===The Prism===
{{SeeAlso|Mission to the Prism}}
{{Quote|This wasn't war... It was just violence.|[[Laurita Tohm]]|<ref name="GhostPrison4" />}}
[[File:SWDarthVaderGhostPrison4.jpg|thumb|left|The team stopping the riot.]]
Using information gleaned from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]], Vader deduced that the only safe haven for the sick Palpatine was at [[the Prism]], a prison facility located near [[Diab 6|Diab's sixth moon]] at the [[Diab system/Legends|Diab system]] that was kept secret by the Jedi Council from even the Supreme Chancellor.

Lacking loyal or trustworthy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Tohm suggested to Vader that the prisoners of the Prism be released and allowed to fight for them, which would allow them to retake [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from Gentis. The Dark Lord amended the young officer's idea, and rather than simply releasing the prisoners, he forced 207 of them to fight one another, as well as the lieutenant and himself, for the right to serve the Galactic Empire. The battle was vicious and wild, with casualties mounting quickly. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Shonn Volta]] allied herself with Tohm after saving his life from General [[Ur'Loach]], while Vader defeated [[Nax Cirvan]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]], who then submitted to the Sith Lord.

In the end, only thirty-three prisoners survived in fighting condition, including Volta and Cirvan. Vader ordered Trachta to tell the survivors what it meant to serve the Empire. Trachta then told the survivors that their crimes were now forgotten, but their reasons for committing them were not&mdash;they would now serve an institution not beholden to the "selfish" [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the Republic, nor the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The prisoners knelt before the Moff and his allies, becoming [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] through their submission.

===Retaking Coruscant===
{{SeeAlso|Battle on Coruscant}}
The coup ended with the [[battle on Coruscant]], in which Palpatine, Vader, and their followers successfully retook the Imperial capital. Afterwards, Vader wiped out all the prisoners from the Prism.<ref name="GhostPrison5" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have great respect for Vader. And a healthy dose of fear. He is an unmatched warrior and unwavering in his loyalty to the Emperor. But he is a ''blunt instrument''. He solves every problem with a lightsaber. He never admits his own mistakes. He has no need of ''allies''&mdash;and he certainly has no interest in mentoring ''anyone''.|Moff Trachta|<ref name="GhostPrison4" />}}
Trachta, promoted to Grand Moff after the incident,<ref name="GhostPrison5" /> later launched his own [[anti-Sith conspiracy]].<ref name="Betrayal 1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref>
